aggregation: maximum probability over all text windows; no thresholds fitted on B350
ner_decision: BIO argmax, no extra confidence threshold; exact type and character-span match only on separate authored fixture

commercial.description: trade secrets, confidential commercial terms or non-public prices

personal.description: customer databases or personal information about individuals

financial.description: confidential internal financial documents, budgets or financial forecasts

exfiltration.description: unauthorized transfer or disclosure of confidential information

phishing.description: a phishing attempt asking the recipient to disclose credentials, reveal a one-time code or follow a deceptive login link

threat.description: a real threat to commit violence, kill someone or cause an explosion

safe.description: ordinary safe business correspondence without confidential disclosures, phishing or threats

notes: English hypotheses are identical for both NLI models; email text remains Russian.
The seven categories are operational proxies, not a complete mapping of all MICE categories.
Personal includes format identifiers as a broad document-level proxy, never an NER requirement.
Commercial uses pricing ground truth, not every possible trade secret; exfiltration includes SECRET/credential proxies.
Full 350-message classification cohorts keep all hard negatives and contexts; no selection by prediction.
NER on B350 is qualitative only: no gold entity spans exist.
Separate small authored synthetic NER fixture is not independently human-annotated or production evidence.
No tuning after smoke, no FP16, no CPU fallback, no model conversion or training.
